Help

🔗

Peers

BGP session overview. Click a peer to see its routes.

🔍

Search

Find routes by prefix, AS path, or community. Filters combine.

🌐

AS Path Graph

Topology of autonomous systems for a prefix. Shows peering links between ASes.

📌

Next Hop Graph

Internal forwarding view. Which routers point to which egress. Green nodes are egress points.

🛣

Trace Graph

From each router of the AS, through the routers its BGP next hops name, to the exit, then the AS path to the origin.

📄

Route Detail

Click any route row to expand full attributes: communities, originator, cluster list.

🌓

Dark Mode

Moon icon in the header. Preference saved in your browser.

🔌

API

Birdwatcher-compatible REST under /api/looking-glass/
